say:1:1631951001:1.text: Honestly, I can't be bothered. I don't think I can keep this shop going much longer anyway.
say:1:1631951001:1.source_cn: 没什么好介绍，这生意也是做不下去了。

say:2:1631951002:1.text: When I sell good stuff at low prices, some customers still nitpick about the quality.
say:2:1631951002:1.source_cn: 卖点物美价廉的东西，会有顾客来刁难。

say:3:1631951003:1.text: When I stock good-value replicas, mages like you show up and call me out.
say:3:1631951003:1.source_cn: 卖点性价比不错的高仿，会有你这样的魔法师过来搅局。
say:3:1631951003:1.male: When I stock good-value replicas, mages like you show up and call me out.
say:3:1631951003:1.female: When I stock good-value replicas, mages like you show up and call me out.

say:4:1631951004:1.text: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.
say:4:1631951004:1.source_cn: 你们一定是嫉妒我的商业头脑。
say:4:1631951004:1.male: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.
say:4:1631951004:1.female: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.

choice_prompt:5:1631951004.text: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.
choice_prompt:5:1631951004.source_cn: 你们一定是嫉妒我的商业头脑。
choice_prompt:5:1631951004.male: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.
choice_prompt:5:1631951004.female: You guys are just salty about how much money I make.

say:6:1631951005:1.text: Hmph, you haven't seen the best of me yet.
say:6:1631951005:1.source_cn: 哼，我的才华肯定不止于此。
say:6:1631951005:1.male: Hmph, you haven't seen the best of me yet.
say:6:1631951005:1.female: Hmph, you haven't seen the best of me yet.

say:7:1631951006:1.text: Once I clear out this batch of stock, I'll move on to selling something else.
say:7:1631951006:1.source_cn: 等我把手里这批货卖掉，我就转型卖一点别的。
say:7:1631951006:1.male: Once I clear out this batch of stock, I'll move on to selling something else.
say:7:1631951006:1.female: Once I clear out this batch of stock, I'll move on to selling something else.

say:8:1631951007:1.text: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.
say:8:1631951007:1.source_cn: 学生们肯定会喜欢一些能飞快提升成绩的好宝贝。
say:8:1631951007:1.male: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.
say:8:1631951007:1.female: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.

choice_prompt:9:1631951007.text: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.
choice_prompt:9:1631951007.source_cn: 学生们肯定会喜欢一些能飞快提升成绩的好宝贝。
choice_prompt:9:1631951007.male: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.
choice_prompt:9:1631951007.female: Like stuff that can boost grades fast. I'm sure students will love them.

say:10:1631951008:1.text: Oh, please. I'm talking about cheap magical supplies.
say:10:1631951008:1.source_cn: 我说的是一些廉价的魔法耗材。
say:10:1631951008:1.male: Oh, please. I'm talking about cheap magical supplies.
say:10:1631951008:1.female: Oh, please. I'm talking about cheap magical supplies.

say:11:1631951009:1.text: I'll have a steady stream of customers from those students.
say:11:1631951009:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的学生肯定用得到，我这可是个铁饭碗。
say:11:1631951009:1.male: I'll have a steady stream of customers from those students.
say:11:1631951009:1.female: I'll have a steady stream of customers from those students.

say:12:1631951010:1.text: See? Money-making ideas just come to me!
say:12:1631951010:1.source_cn: 果然，我一定能找到发大财的机会！
say:12:1631951010:1.male: See? Money-making ideas just come to me!
say:12:1631951010:1.female: See? Money-making ideas just come to me!

choice:5:1:2.text: You're not much of a businessman.
choice:5:1:2.male: You're not much of a businessman.
choice:5:1:2.female: You're not much of a businessman.
